thread:
maria: quick check-in on the edge->central abuse forwarding prototype. want to square on privacy/accuracy/slo tradeoffs before we merge.

 tim: brief recap: edges emit an "abuse event" to central for correlation. naive forwarding included full payloads which freaked legal out. also added ~25ms p99 tail on some routes.

 alice: proposal: 3-stage pipeline: (1) local heuristic -> (2) compact salted fingerprint + provenance -> (3) central aggregate. full payload forwarded only on explicit follow-up.

 ben: agree. fingerprint should be collision-resistant across tenants. sketch: `sig = base64url(HKDF(salt || tenant || event_json))` where salt is region-scoped.

 nisha: also important: include a monotonic sequence id so central can dedupe replayed/batched deliveries. header idea: `X-Abuse-Fp`, `X-Abuse-Region`, `X-Abuse-Seq`, `X-Abuse-TTL`.

 maria: can we make local mitigation first-class? edges should be able to apply reversible soft actions (429s, slow-path) without waiting for central. central remains authoritative for account-wide blocks.

 tim: yes. implement local_policy_strength enum: OFF/OBSERVE/SOFT/MODERATE. default = OBSERVE in prod. SOFT permits transient rejects up to 10s.

 alice: telemetry: we need metrics to detect fingerprint drift/collisions: total_fps, unique_raw_samples_for_fp, collision_rate, forward_rate, local_degrade_rate. surface them per region + per-tenant for high-volume.

 ben: sampling job: when an fp is seen N times in T window, capture k raw events to secure vault for manual review. retention policy: staging 3d, prod 30d only for opt-in customers.

 nisha: legal: full-payload export should default OFF and be enterprise opt-in. require consent + data processing addendum. store raw samples in locked bucket with IAM filter.

 security-bot: alert: dev-run produced 860 fps from staging-edge-7. sample id=ab4c1. raw samples auto-archived to vault-qa for 72h.

 tim: header sketch (proto):
```
X-Abuse-Fp: sha256=Z3Vh...;
X-Abuse-Region: eu-central-1;
X-Abuse-Seq: 00001234;
X-Abuse-TTL: 45;
X-Abuse-Trace: trace=abcd-1234
```

 alice: note: TTL in header is seconds local trust before central must see it. edges drop ttl-expired events to bound storage/processing.

 ben: salt rotation: region salt rotated by k8s secret every 90d. include `salt-v` in header to allow central to accept recent rotations with a replay tolerance window (5m).

 maria: what about cross-tenant correlation attacks? adversary could craft payloads to match another tenant's fp if tenant id isn't included in derivation. must include tenant id and secret salt.

 nisha: confirm: fp computation must be done in edge process space with HSM/KMS access restricted to infra. avoid logging raw event anywhere unless flagged.

 tim: rollout plan: 1) merge fp-only forwarder behind feature flag; 2) canary 2% edges in us-east for 24h with verbose telemetry; 3) bump to 10%/48h; 4) enable global with default OBSERVE after 7d if metrics OK.

 alice: add circuit-breaker: if central backpressure > threshold, edges must stop forwarding and switch to local-only mode. surface in console as "abuse-forwarding-state".

 ben: implementation items: edge sdk fp lib (C++/go), header encoding lib, central dedupe/rolling-window aggregator, sampling job, console widgets.

 maria: acceptance criteria: collision_rate < 0.001 at tenant scale X, local_degrade_false_positive_rate < 0.5% on canary, end-to-end p99 added latency < 10ms for fp path, legal signoff for opt-in flow.

 nisha: i'll draft the legal blurb and access controls. alice, can you mock the console panels?

 alice: on it. will post mock images + metric names in the follow-up RFC.

 tim: i'll write the short RFC follow-up with interfaces, salt rotation, and rollout steps. tagging infra for canary allocation.

 maria: thanks all. once RFC is out i'll create an oncall runbook for escalations (who to call if sampling shows large-scale abuse). :white_check_mark:

 security-bot: reminder: include retention & access matrix in RFC and tie to AD groups (sec, oncall, legal).
